architecture.summary: A local multi-tenant store with API, worker, and fixture database boundaries.

blocked_checks.reason: Cloud account was out of scope.

findings.attacker_control: The caller could reach the listing endpoint while the seller lookup returned no identity.
findings.boundary_failure: Missing identity produced an unscoped query instead of failing closed.
findings.fix: Reject a missing seller subject before constructing the query.
findings.impact: A seller could read listing metadata belonging to other tenants.

evidence: local two-seller fixture reproduced the boundary failure

findings.reachability: The route passed the missing identifier into the query builder.

regression.assertion: missing seller identity returns 403 and no rows

findings.reproduction: Use the local seller-without-profile fixture and assert the old handler returns cross-tenant rows.
findings.residual_risk: Sibling background jobs require separate applicability review.
findings.root_cause: The canonical authorization helper treated a missing subject as an absent filter.
findings.title: Missing seller identity previously widened a listing query

findings.attacker_control: Request identifiers are partially caller influenced.
findings.boundary_failure: The local log retention window exceeds the documented fixture requirement.
findings.fix: Set an explicit fixture retention duration.
findings.impact: Local-only correlation data persists longer than intended.
findings.reachability: Identifiers are written by the local diagnostic middleware.
findings.regression: Assert fixture logs expire after the configured duration.
findings.reproduction: Run one local request and inspect the isolated fixture log.
findings.residual_risk: Production logging was out of scope.
findings.root_cause: The fixture cleanup job uses the default retention period.
findings.title: Verbose local diagnostics retain request identifiers

rejected_findings.reason: The URL reaches a local allowlisted provider mock only.
